description: Known-bad Android code signing certificates for malware family attribution

certificates.notes: Judy malware campaign - Google Play 2017. One of the largest malware operations on Google Play, with an estimated 36.5 million downloads across 41 apps.
ExpensiveWall malware - Google Play 2017. Premium SMS scamming malware that evaded Google Play Protect.
AndroRAT - Android Remote Access Trojan, open-source surveillance tool repurposed by multiple threat actors.
Xavier malware - 2017 ad library malware found in popular Android apps on Google Play. Part of the AdDown family.
CamScanner trojanized app - 2019. Popular document scanner app on Google Play containing Trojan dropper.
Premium-SMS fraud kit: shared by 7-sample campaign (6 relabeled + 1 GT) with shared code + umeng C2; see reports/campaign_bundles.json
